metadata.description: Image-derived settlement outlines & built-up footprint status for MACONFLIC study area

properties.name: Kondanur
properties.alignment_status: NOT GEOREFERENCED (Lacks World File / Precise Control Points)
properties.extraction_method: High-reflectance cluster segmentation along road junction
properties.notes: Original screenshot (kodanur.png) captures central hamlet cluster around junction with western spur. Due to absence of georeferencing world file (.pgw) or sub-meter control points, geographic polygon is withheld to prevent arbitrary spatial distortion on basemap.

properties.name: Pudur
properties.alignment_status: NOT GEOREFERENCED (Lacks World File / Precise Control Points)
properties.extraction_method: Enclosed northern compound cluster & southern hamlet segmentation
properties.notes: Original screenshot (pudur.png) captures distinct northern walled residential/farm enclave (enclosed by road loop) and southern junction clusters. Due to lack of embedded spatial reference bounds, polygon is withheld from automatic projection.

properties.name: Panapalli
properties.alignment_status: NOT GEOREFERENCED (Lacks World File / Precise Control Points)
properties.extraction_method: Linear terrace road settlement cluster extraction
properties.notes: Original screenshot (panapalli.png) displays compact, high-density residential buildings strung along central winding mountain road with surrounding agricultural terraces. Ground control points are insufficient for rigorous affine projection.

properties.name: Kandivalli / Kandivazhi
properties.alignment_status: NOT GEOREFERENCED (Lacks World File / Precise Control Points)
properties.notes: Original screenshot (kandivazhi.png) depicts two distinct built-up nuclei: western hillside hamlet and eastern roadway hamlet with agricultural clearings. Spatial bounds not georeferenced.

properties.name: Sembukarai
properties.alignment_status: PARTIAL METADATA (Overlay Map Scale 1:8,859 | Level 16, Route 164 / Thadagam Road)
properties.notes: Screenshot displays Thadagam Road (SH 164) and Esri scale watermark '1:8,859 | Level 16'. While highway alignment and scale are visible, corner geodetic coordinates remain uncalibrated without GIS control points.

properties.name: Dhoomanur / Dhoomanoor
properties.alignment_status: MISSING SOURCE SCREENSHOT & UNRESOLVED GROUND TRUTH
properties.notes: No Esri Wayback screenshot or verified coordinates exist in the project for Dhoomanur. Outlines were not fabricated.

properties.name: Thuvaipathy / Thuvaipathi
properties.notes: Reference point available in maconflic-settlements.geojson, but no Esri Wayback screenshot exists in data/Seven Villages/. Outlines were not fabricated.
